versos.hebraico: נִבְחָ֣ר שֵׁ֭ם מֵעֹ֣שֶׁר רָ֑ב מִכֶּ֥סֶף וּ֝מִזָּהָ֗ב חֵ֣ן טֽוֹב׃

controles.web: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.
controles.kjv: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
controles.livre: É preferível ter um bom nome do que muitas riquezas; e ser favorecido é melhor que a prata e o o ouro.

versos.hebraico: עָשִׁ֣יר וָרָ֣שׁ נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ עֹשֵׂ֖ה כֻלָּ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: The rich and the poor have this in common: Yahweh is the maker of them all.
controles.kjv: The rich and poor meet together: the Lord is the maker of them all.
controles.livre: O rico e o pobre se encontram; todos eles foram feitos pelo SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: עָר֤וּם׀ רָאָ֣ה רָעָ֣ה ויסתר וּ֝פְתָיִ֗ים עָבְר֥וּ וְֽנֶעֱנָֽשׁוּ׃

controles.web: A prudent man sees danger, and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
controles.kjv: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.
controles.livre: O prudente vê o mal, e se esconde; mas os ingênuos passam e sofrem as consequências.

versos.hebraico: עֵ֣קֶב עֲ֭נָוָה יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֖שֶׁר וְכָב֣וֹד וְחַיִּֽים׃

controles.web: The result of humility and the fear of Yahweh is wealth, honor, and life.
controles.kjv: By humility and the fear of the Lord are riches, and honour, and life.
controles.livre: A recompensa da humildade e do temor ao SENHOR são riquezas, honra, e vida.

versos.hebraico: צִנִּ֣ים פַּ֭חִים בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ עִקֵּ֑שׁ שׁוֹמֵ֥ר נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ יִרְחַ֥ק מֵהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked: whoever guards his soul stays from them.
controles.kjv: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.
controles.livre: Há espinhos e ciladas no caminho do perverso; quem cuida de sua alma deve ficar longe de tal caminho .

versos.hebraico: חֲנֹ֣ךְ לַ֭נַּעַר עַל־פִּ֣י דַרְכּ֑וֹ גַּ֥ם כִּֽי־יַ֝זְקִ֗ין לֹֽא־יָס֥וּר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃

controles.web: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
controles.kjv: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
controles.livre: Instrui ao menino em seu caminho, e até quando envelhecer, não se desviará dele.

versos.hebraico: עָ֭שִׁיר בְּרָשִׁ֣ים יִמְשׁ֑וֹל וְעֶ֥בֶד לֹ֝וֶ֗ה לְאִ֣ישׁ מַלְוֶֽה׃

controles.web: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.
controles.kjv: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.
controles.livre: O rico domina sobre os pobres, e quem toma emprestado é servo daquele que empresta.

versos.hebraico: זוֹרֵ֣עַ עַ֭וְלָה יקצור־אָ֑וֶן וְשֵׁ֖בֶט עֶבְרָת֣וֹ יִכְלֶֽה׃

controles.web: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.
controles.kjv: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.
controles.livre: Aquele que semeia perversidade colherá sofrimento; e a vara de sua ira se acabará.

versos.hebraico: טֽוֹב־עַ֭יִן ה֣וּא יְבֹרָ֑ךְ כִּֽי־נָתַ֖ן מִלַּחְמ֣וֹ לַדָּֽל׃

controles.web: He who has a generous eye will be blessed; for he shares his food with the poor.
controles.kjv: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.
controles.livre: Quem tem olhos bondosos será abençoado, porque deu de seu pão ao pobre.

versos.hebraico: גָּ֣רֵֽשׁ לֵ֭ץ וְיֵצֵ֣א מָד֑וֹן וְ֝יִשְׁבֹּ֗ת דִּ֣ין וְקָלֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop.
controles.kjv: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.
controles.livre: Expulsa ao zombador, e a briga terminará; cessará a disputa e a vergonha.

versos.hebraico: אֹהֵ֥ב טהור־לֵ֑ב חֵ֥ן שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו רֵעֵ֥הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ׃

controles.web: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.
controles.kjv: He that loveth pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.
controles.livre: Quem ama a pureza do coração fala graciosamente com os lábios, e o rei será seu amigo.

versos.hebraico: עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה נָ֣צְרוּ דָ֑עַת וַ֝יְסַלֵּ֗ף דִּבְרֵ֥י בֹגֵֽד׃

controles.web: The eyes of Yahweh watch over knowledge; but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.
controles.kjv: The eyes of the Lord preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.
controles.livre: Os olhos do SENHOR protegem o conhecimento; porém ele transtornará as palavras do enganador.

versos.hebraico: אָמַ֣ר עָ֭צֵל אֲרִ֣י בַח֑וּץ בְּת֥וֹךְ רְ֝חֹב֗וֹת אֵֽרָצֵֽחַ׃

controles.web: The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”
controles.kjv: The slothful man saith, There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets.
controles.livre: O preguiçoso diz: Há um leão lá fora! Ele me matará nas ruas!

versos.hebraico: שׁוּחָ֣ה עֲ֭מֻקָּה פִּ֣י זָר֑וֹת זְע֥וּם יְ֝הוָ֗ה יפול־שָֽׁם׃

controles.web: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit: he who is under Yahweh’s wrath will fall into it.
controles.kjv: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of the Lord shall fall therein.
controles.livre: A boca da mulher pervertida é uma cova profunda; aquele contra quem o SENHOR se irar cairá nela.

versos.hebraico: אִ֭וֶּלֶת קְשׁוּרָ֣ה בְלֶב־נָ֑עַר שֵׁ֥בֶט מ֝וּסָ֗ר יַרְחִיקֶ֥נָּה מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child: the rod of discipline drives it far from him.
controles.kjv: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.
controles.livre: A tolice está amarrada ao coração do menino; mas a vara da correção a mandará para longe dele.

versos.hebraico: עֹ֣שֵֽׁק דָּ֭ל לְהַרְבּ֣וֹת ל֑וֹ נֹתֵ֥ן לְ֝עָשִׁ֗יר אַךְ־לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃

controles.web: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.
controles.kjv: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches, and he that giveth to the rich, shall surely come to want.
controles.livre: Aquele que oprime ao pobre para proveito próprio e aquele que dá suborno ao rico certamente empobrecerão.

versos.hebraico: הַ֥ט אָזְנְךָ֗ וּ֭שְׁמַע דִּבְרֵ֣י חֲכָמִ֑ים וְ֝לִבְּךָ֗ תָּשִׁ֥ית לְדַעְתִּֽי׃

controles.web: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.
controles.kjv: Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thine heart unto my knowledge.
controles.livre: Inclina o teu ouvido e escuta as palavras dos sábios; dispõe teu coração ao meu conhecimento;

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־נָ֭עִים כִּֽי־תִשְׁמְרֵ֣ם בְּבִטְנֶ֑ךָ יִכֹּ֥נוּ יַ֝חְדָּ֗ו עַל־שְׂפָתֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.
controles.kjv: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips.
controles.livre: porque é agradável que as guardes dentro de ti, e estejam prontas para os teus lábios;

versos.hebraico: לִהְי֣וֹת בַּ֭יהוָה מִבְטַחֶ֑ךָ הוֹדַעְתִּ֖יךָ הַיּ֣וֹם אַף־אָֽתָּה׃

controles.web: That your trust may be in Yahweh, I teach you today, even you.
controles.kjv: That thy trust may be in the Lord, I have made known to thee this day, even to thee.
controles.livre: para que tua confiança esteja no SENHOR, eu as ensino a ti hoje.

versos.hebraico: הֲלֹ֤א כָתַ֣בְתִּי לְ֭ךָ שלשום בְּמ֖וֹעֵצֹ֣ת וָדָֽעַת׃

controles.web: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,
controles.kjv: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge,
controles.livre: Por acaso não te escrevi excelentes  coisas sobre o conselho e o conhecimento,

versos.hebraico: לְהוֹדִֽיעֲךָ֗ קֹ֭שְׁטְ אִמְרֵ֣י אֱמֶ֑ת לְהָשִׁ֥יב אֲמָרִ֥ים אֱ֝מֶ֗ת לְשֹׁלְחֶֽיךָ׃פ

controles.web: To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?
controles.kjv: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?
controles.livre: para te ensinar a certeza das palavras da verdade, para que possas responder palavras de verdade aos que te enviarem?

versos.hebraico: אַֽל־תִּגְזָל־דָּ֭ל כִּ֣י דַל־ה֑וּא וְאַל־תְּדַכֵּ֖א עָנִ֣י בַשָּֽׁעַר׃

controles.web: Don’t exploit the poor, because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;
controles.kjv: Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:
controles.livre: Não roubes ao pobre, porque ele é pobre; nem oprimas ao aflito junto à porta do julgamento.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־יְ֭הוָה יָרִ֣יב רִיבָ֑ם וְקָבַ֖ע אֶת־קֹבְעֵיהֶ֣ם נָֽפֶשׁ׃

controles.web: for Yahweh will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.
controles.kjv: For the Lord will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.
controles.livre: Porque o SENHOR defenderá a causa deles em juízo, e quanto aos que os roubam, ele lhes roubará a alma.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תִּ֭תְרַע אֶת־בַּ֣עַל אָ֑ף וְאֶת־אִ֥ישׁ חֵ֝מוֹת לֹ֣א תָבֽוֹא׃

controles.web: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man, and don’t associate with one who harbors anger:
controles.kjv: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:
controles.livre: Não seja companheiro de quem se irrita facilmente, nem andes com o homem furioso,

versos.hebraico: פֶּן־תֶּאֱלַ֥ף ארחתו וְלָקַחְתָּ֖ מוֹקֵ֣שׁ לְנַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃

controles.web: lest you learn his ways, and ensnare your soul.
controles.kjv: Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.
controles.livre: Para que não aprendas o caminho dele, e te ponhas em armadilhas para tua alma.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תְּהִ֥י בְתֹֽקְעֵי־כָ֑ף בַּ֝עֹרְבִ֗ים מַשָּׁאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.
controles.kjv: Be not thou one of them that strike hands, or of them that are sureties for debts.
controles.livre: Não estejas entre os que se comprometem em acordos com as mãos, ou os que ficam por fiadores de dívidas.

versos.hebraico: אִם־אֵֽין־לְךָ֥ לְשַׁלֵּ֑ם לָ֥מָּה יִקַּ֥ח מִ֝שְׁכָּבְךָ֗ מִתַּחְתֶּֽיךָ׃

controles.web: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?
controles.kjv: If thou hast nothing to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?
controles.livre: Se não tens como pagar, por que razão tirariam tua cama debaixo de ti?

versos.hebraico: אַל־תַּ֭סֵּג גְּב֣וּל עוֹלָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עָשׂ֣וּ אֲבוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone, which your fathers have set up.
controles.kjv: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.
controles.livre: Não mudes os limites antigos que teus pais fizeram.

versos.hebraico: חָזִ֡יתָ אִ֤ישׁ׀ מָ֘הִ֤יר בִּמְלַאכְתּ֗וֹ לִֽפְנֵֽי־מְלָכִ֥ים יִתְיַצָּ֑ב בַּל־יִ֝תְיַצֵּב לִפְנֵ֥י חֲשֻׁכִּֽים׃פ

controles.web: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.
controles.kjv: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.
controles.livre: Viste um homem habilidoso em sua obra? Perante a face dos reis ele será posto; ele não será posto diante de pessoas sem honra.
